resources.string: Shows a dictation bubble when you focus a text field, and types the dictated text into that field. It reads the focused field and nearby screen text only while a dictation is in progress.
Stop and insert. Long press to cancel.
openWisprFlow needs microphone access. Open the app and tap Allow microphone.
The dictation service is on. Focus a text field in any app and tap the bubble.

To turn it on: Accessibility → openWisprFlow dictation → Use openWisprFlow dictation.\n\nIf the switch is greyed out (\"restricted setting\"), go to App info → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then try again.

Build step 8: tap the bubble to record, tap again (■) to stop, long press to cancel. The cleaned transcript is inserted if the same field is still focused and unchanged; otherwise it is shown with Copy.
Your own Vercel AI Gateway key. It is stored encrypted on this phone and sent only to ai-gateway.vercel.sh. Audio and field text go there only while you dictate.
The key works and google/gemini-3.5-transcribe answered.
Add your AI Gateway API key in openWisprFlow first.
Names and terms the speech model should spell your way, one per line. After \"=\", add ways a term tends to be misheard, separated by commas.
Use names on screen as hints

While you dictate, name-like words near the text field (people, places, product names) are sent with the audio as spelling hints. With cleanup on, up to 1,500 characters of text near the field also go to the cleanup model as context.
Show live text while you talk (experimental)

Streams the audio to Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live as you speak and shows the words above the bubble. The live model\'s transcript is then inserted after you stop; it can miss words that the normal upload catches. If streaming fails, the recording is uploaded as usual.
Clean up with Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite

A second call rewrites the verbatim transcript into text ready to insert: punctuation, fillers removed, spoken corrections resolved. It sees the text around the cursor, your dictionary and, with screen hints on, text near the field. Off: the speech model\'s own tidy transcript is inserted, one call instead of two.
Cleanup prompt. The app always adds rules that keep screen text as data and the reply as JSON.

Your dictations, newest first, stored only on this phone. Audio is kept for 24 hours so a take can be retried; a retry\'s result is offered for copy and never typed into a field. Incognito fields leave no history.
Transcription failed: %1$s. You can retry it from History.
